title: SegaSonic The Hedgehog (Japan, prototype)
mra_descriptor_differs: upstream has no MRA for the prototype. Against the retail set's descriptor: byte 2 = 00 (no protection responder: MAME's init_sonicp is the common init only) and byte 3 = 81 (8 MB of sprite ROM, as Spider-Man)
input_profile_note: 1 = World wiring: Coin 1 on SERVICE12 bit 2, 1P Start on SERVICE12 bit 4. With the trackball profile the d-pads of pads 1 / 2 drive the trackball directions (u1_controls)
video_options_note: 1: sprites win equal-priority ties against NBG0, as in the retail set, where the rule follows from prot_sel = 7; here the explicit bit carries it
expected_sums_source: checksums of the slot files built privately from this ROM set (not ROM data); band off, not consumed
